frontier.hypothesis: Class C (3 diffs, rows 62-64) is a local-alloc dest-coalesce between two dying input pseudos and is now a SOLVER question, not a spelling question. Eight address shapes are measured dead.
frontier.mechanism: Rows 60 and 61 are byte-identical (`lw $v0,%gp_rel(D_800A36A0)`, `sll $v1,$v1,1`); only the following addu differs - ours ties the dest to the lw pseudo ($v0) with operands (lw, sll), the target ties it to the sll pseudo ($v1) with operands (sll, lw). Both inputs die at that insn, so the tie is a local-alloc/reload preference, and C1 proves pointer-domain PLUS canonicalization removes source order from the equation.

frontier.hypothesis: Class A (4 diffs, prologue rows 7-12) may be sched2-unreachable: the target's emission order is ours exactly reversed, and only five of the eight priority-1 insns have C-controllable LUIDs.
frontier.mechanism: sched2 block 0 'from 546 to 81' has every contested insn at priority 1, so rank_for_schedule falls through to its dependence-class and INSN_LUID tie-breaks plus the 'greater potential hazard' reordering. The five save insns' LUIDs are fixed by save_restore_insns; only {15 addiu s1, 26 a0 load, 28 a1 const, 18/21 sh stores} follow C statement order, and sched1's output order for that subset was [15, 26, 28, 18, 21] under every one of the twelve orderings measured.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/sched_solver on sched2 block 0 with the target's emission order (548, 554, 28, 26, 15) as the goal. It is order- and clock-exact, so it returns REACHABLE with the required LUID permutation (which then becomes a concrete C question) or FORECLOSED. That verdict is worth more than another dozen statement permutations.

frontier.hypothesis: Class B (2 diffs, rows 35-36) needs the raw func_8006E49C result to stay live past the copy into p_old, and no C spelling produces that without triggering a cse forward.
frontier.mechanism: Our call-result pseudo is `Register 80 used 2 times` (set plus the copy into p_old), so it dies at the copy; the target uses it four times. Every C form naming the value twice makes cse forward the handle and DELETE the D_800A35D0 loop-preheader reload, a 5-insn collapse (K1, K4). B1-B4 show restating the store addresses is byte-neutral.
